svg.title: Two distinct signals, identical samples
svg.desc: Analytic 0.2 and 1.2 cycle-per-pixel cosines with a phase shift of minus pi coincide at every half-integer sample center.
svg.text: Green: 0.2 cycles/pixel • Brown: 1.2 cycles/pixel, phase shifted by −π • Dots: identical samples
Sampling cannot distinguish these two continuous cosine signals at half-integer locations.
